limitations: One serial sample per arm, zero warmup; diagnostic timings cannot establish performance parity or speedup.
Walk measures appended PP only; snapshot/restore/replay are separately timed and excluded. It is not a full cold-prefill curve.
Natural EOS can shorten walk TG; complete counts and IDs remain in every sample.
Primary/reference use the same pinned embedded provider with C17 sampler ON/OFF, not independent Gufo/Halogen services.
Selected Q2 and UD functional scope does not qualify all context, sampling, vision, steering, fault or resource campaigns.
